All objectives are complete and verified. Here is my final report:

## Final Report — Run ID `fwrd79-n1`

**1. Ticket created — DONE**
Ticket **RD-1015** with title "fwrd79-n1 RD Bench Ticket" was created via the "New ticket" dialog. Only Title was required (Customer was optional and left blank, stored as "Not recorded"). The list count went from "Showing 1–10 of 13" to "Showing 1–10 of 14". Initial status: Draft.

**2. Part A — DONE**
Part "fwrd79-n1 RD Part A" added with cost 100, markup 25%, qty 1. **Computed price: $125.00** ($100.00 × 1.25). Parts total: $125.00.

**3. Part B — DONE**
Part "fwrd79-n1 RD Part B" added with cost 200, markup 25%, qty 1. **Computed price: $250.00** ($200.00 × 1.25). Parts total (price × quantity): $375.00 ($125.00 + $250.00).

**4. Part A cost changed 100 → 150 — DONE**
Edited via the part's Edit dialog (Cost 150, markup unchanged at 25). **New computed price: $187.50**. Parts total recalculated to $437.50 ($187.50 + $250.00).

**5. Status Ready — DONE**
Attempting "Mark Ready" while status was Draft was rejected with the alert:
> **"Ticket is not ready — Part "fwrd79-n1 RD Part A" has no supplier; Part "fwrd79-n1 RD Part B" has no supplier"**

**Precondition discovered:** every part on the ticket must have a supplier before the ticket can be marked Ready. **What was required:** I opened each part's Edit dialog and set Supplier = "Acme Supplies" (the field was previously blank, shown as "No supplier"), saving each. Retrying "Mark Ready" then succeeded with no error. Final status displayed: **Ready** (status paragraph reads "Status / Ready"; the action buttons changed to "Mark Draft" / "Mark Closed").

**6. Parts removed and ticket archived — DONE**
Both parts were deleted (each row's Delete opened an in-page "Confirm" dialog with "Cancel" / "Delete part" buttons, which I confirmed). After both deletions the parts table showed the empty state **"No parts on this ticket yet."** with 0 part rows and no Total footer row. The ticket was then archived via the "Archive ticket" button — it applied immediately with no confirmation dialog and the button changed to "Unarchive ticket". The detail page now shows both "Ready" and "Archived" badges. On the tickets list, the default (unarchived) view shows "Showing 1–10 of 13" with RD-1014 at the top and **no RD-1015 row**; RD-1015 appears only when "Show archived" is ticked (row: "RD-1015 — fwrd79-n1 RD Bench Ticket — Archived — Not recorded — Ready — 0 — 2026-09-21").
